summary: The SiteProfileClosures module manages the closure process of site profiles, involving destination management and discipline processing. It handles the addition, update, and deletion of closures and their associated destinations, with support for both selected and applied destinations.
purpose: The purpose of the SiteProfileClosures module is to manage the lifecycle of site closures, including the selection and management of destinations and disciplines associated with those closures. This includes operations like adding, editing, deleting closures, and managing applied destinations.

workflows.name: Closure Management
steps: Load site closures and filter by discipline.
Handle add, edit, and delete operations on closures.
Manage applied destinations for selected closures.
Save changes and update destinations accordingly.

business_rules: Only edit operations are allowed if the screen is editable.
Destinations are filtered to exclude already applied ones.
validations: Ensure user session is active before operations.
Validate data binding and control visibility based on role and session.
conditions: Check if closure ID and site ID are greater than 0 to proceed.
Determine if all sub-disciplines are allowed or specific ones are selected.
system_behavior: Modifies ViewState to track applied destinations and current closure settings.
Redirects and updates UI components based on user actions and data changes.
exceptions: Cancel operations if user session is not available.
Handle empty or malformed destination data gracefully.
